a) The acceleration of a particle at any time \(t \geq 0\) is given by:

$$
a = \frac{dv}{dt} = 12 \cos 2ti - 8 \sin tj + 16tk.
$$

If the velocity \(v\) and displacement \(r\) are zero at \(t = 0\), determine \(v\) and \(r\) **(6 marks)**

b) If \(\vec{u} = t^2i - tj + (2t + 1)k\) and \(\vec{v} = (2t - 3)i + j - tk\), determine \(\frac{d}{dt}(\vec{u} \cdot \vec{v})\), when \(t = 1\) **(4 marks)**

c) Determine the divergence and curl of \(\vec{F} = (x^2 - y^2)i + 2xyj + (y^2 - xy)k\) **(6 marks)**

d) Determine the area of the triangle having vertices at \(P(1,3,2), Q(2, -1,1)\) and \(R(-1,2,3)\) **(4 marks)**
